verdicts.reason: A is basically a scaled-down copy of the original centered on a narrow panel with empty grey bands on both sides. The quote and attribution stay legible and in order, and the brand is intact. But the text is small, the layout is not rearranged for the banner shape, and the side areas are dead space. B has a different layout, but it is broken. The quote and attribution sit in the top half of a large red block with a big empty red area below. A stray underline cuts through 'MODERN', and the stray rule lines are misplaced. The skyline is shrunk and cut off in a separate white panel with no connection to the text. The attribution floats to the right of the quote with a weak hierarchy.
